keyVerseDR: "Amen I say to you that no prophet is accepted in his own country." (Lk 4:24)

level1.title: Jesus Is Not Welcome
level1.story: Jesus spoke in His hometown. At first people liked His words. Then they got angry and tried to push Him off a cliff! But Jesus walked right through them.
level1.keyLine: I will be brave for Jesus.
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: When is it hard to do right?

activity.title: Sing bravely
activity.intro: Tap the rhythm and sing a hymn to Jesus.
items: Tap the beat with my hands
Say, I will be brave for Jesus!

level2.title: No Prophet Accepted at Home
level2.story: Jesus said in the synagogue, "This day is fulfilled this scripture in your ears." All wondered at His gracious words and said, "Is not this the son of Joseph?" Jesus said, "No prophet is accepted in his own country." He reminded them that Elijah and Elisha were sent to help foreigners. The people were filled with anger and led Him to a cliff to throw Him down, but He passed through the midst of them and went His way.
level2.keyLine: No prophet is accepted in his own country.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: Why were the people so angry?
How can you stay brave when others reject your faith?
actions: Be kind to those who disagree
level2.prayer: Jesus, give me courage to follow You. Amen.

activity.title: Jesus, I wonder...
activity.intro: Jesus stayed brave when people were angry. Write what you wonder.
starters: Jesus, I wonder how You felt...
I wonder why they got angry...
